_note: REST (owner: resting should sit you down, heal you and lower exhaustion). The docs name the places and their order but give no numbers: spec 01:19 (tents, beds, campfires, safe camps; conditions affect recovery), PRD :118 (a residence is the main fatigue dump), PRD :285 (bonfire sitting effects), PRD :803 (tents are cheap fatigue management). Every rate here is an ASSUMPTION. hp_per_s adds to the passive 0.8 HP/s regen (vitals.gd); the open rate is small because PRD :118 has Health slowly auto-recover and medicine as the real refill, so the fire and shelter are the bonuses; fatigue_per_min comes off the 0-100 fatigue scale. Sleep at a tent or bed recovers at the shelter rate while asleep and keeps its full restore on completion. Statuses change the rates (spec 01:19, rest_state.gd): damage-over-time ticks come off Health and pause passive regen, blocks_regen stops rest healing, and a status fatigue_mult (Dirty, Very Dirty, Thirsty, Clean) divides fatigue recovery.
_shelter_note: ASSUMPTION: no closed-house test exists yet (W2-CONSTRUCT, spec 10:108). Sitting within shelter_reach_m of one of these buildings counts as shelter; a house kind joins this list when houses exist.
_fire_note: PRD :285: the bonfire clears Wet; while sitting, heat +20 %, cold -20 %.
_combat_note: Rest is refused for this long after a hit, as Sleep is (player_sim.gd start_sleep).
_well_rested_note: Owner 2026-10-28: on waking from a sleep (completed, or ended by moving after at least min_sleep_s), grant the well_rested status: exhaustion gains are blocked, recovery still works, the HUD treadmill pauses. ASSUMPTION (no doc figure): secs_per_point seconds per point of exhaustion the sleep removed, clamped to min_s..max_s; a full tent sleep from 60 gives 180 s. A sleep ended by a hit, combat or death grants nothing.
